props.gloss_en: over bread one says 'hamotzi lechem min haaretz'
R' Nechemya: over bread one says 'motzi lechem min haaretz'
Rava: over 'motzi' everyone agrees that it connotes 'brought out'
as it is written: 'God who brought them out of Egypt' (Num 23:22)
Rava: where they disagree is over 'hamotzi'
the Rabbanan hold that 'hamotzi' connotes 'brought out'
as it is written: 'who brought out for you water from the flinty rock' (Deut 8:15)
R' Nechemya holds that 'hamotzi' connotes 'brings out'
as it is said: '...who brings you out from under the burdens of Egypt' (Ex 6:7)
